limits: Errors are illustrative bounds, not measured process capabilities or probabilities
Error vectors are conservatively aligned in the unfavorable direction; failing a bound does not prove every real assembly fails
Zero margin means ideal contact and is not counted as usable clearance
Cylinders and axes are rigid and parallel; no surface finish, chamfer capture, friction, swelling, wear or pin return force is solved
Nominal backlash excludes pivot and guide clearance, elasticity and stop surfaces
No manufacturing tolerance or product qualification is granted
